summary.caption: Widescreen family fantasy adventure key art, three unlikely young heroes on a windblown ridge before a colossal floating castle and friendly cloud dragon, radiant sunrise, turquoise and apricot sky, sweeping painterly scale and optimistic theatrical composition.

items.label: object
items.caption: A colossal floating castle of pale stone, waterfalls and windmills suspended among clouds in the upper centre, with a long friendly cloud dragon circling its towers.

items.label: character
items.caption: Foreground left: brave young mapmaker in a mustard coat holding an unfurled glowing chart, windblown full-body stance looking toward the castle.

items.label: character
items.caption: Foreground centre: cheerful small moss-covered stone guardian carrying a travel pack, broad stable full-body silhouette.

items.label: character
items.caption: Foreground right: inventive young sky-sailor in turquoise overalls holding a brass glider wing, confident full-body stance looking toward the castle.

items.label: text
items.caption: Large joyful ivory adventure title across the upper sky.
